logp.method_description: Water or phosphate-buffered saline (PBS) was stirred with octanol for 24 h, and then the mixture was centrifuged for 5 min to obtain octanol-saturated water and water-saturated octanol. 1 and 2 were dissolved in the octanol-saturated water (or PBS for cisplatin) at a typical concentration of 0.05 to 5 mM, and then they were mixed with water-saturated octanol in volumetric ratios of 1:1, 1:2, and 2:1. All mixtures were prepared in duplicate. The mixtures were vortexed for 0.5 h, and then they were centrifuged for 5 min. The layers were separated carefully using a fine-gauge needle. The Ir content in the layers was analyzed by graphite furnace atomic absorption spectroscopy (GFAAS). The partition coefficient was taken as the ratio of the concentration of Ir in the octanol layer to that in the aqueous layer (P = coct/cwater). The reported error is the standard deviation of triplicate measurements obtained according to this protocol.
